title: Bisaya basics
about: The most common words of Bisaya (Cebuano), counted in the Cebuano web text of OPUS's NLLB collection (ODC-By 1.0) and grouped by root with tools/course/ceb/rank.mjs, most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people and places, and English words, are left out. Verbs are listed by their root (kaon, to eat), as Bisaya dictionaries list them. Each word has one short everyday sentence that uses it the way people in Cebu say it, with its English translation; ⟦ ⟧ marks the part that translates the word.

words.meaning: at; in; to; of (a place, a direction)
that; who; which (joins a word to what describes it)
words.sentence: Mao ni ang libro nga akong gibasa.
words.translation: This is the book ⟦that⟧ I read.

words.meaning: the (marks who or what the sentence is about)

words.translation: I didn't go ⟦because⟧ it was raining.

words.meaning: it is (the one); that's it; mao ba?: really?
this (short for kini); of (before a name)
there is; to have (adunay ...: there is a ...)
(before a person's name or a title like Mama)
also; too; again (in speech also sad, pud)
a; some (before the thing a verb acts on)

words.sentence: Nagtuon ko og maayo aron makapasar.
words.translation: I studied hard ⟦so that⟧ I'd pass.

words.meaning: to say; like (ingon niini: like this)
this; of this (after a verb or sa)
can; may; it's possible; to become

words.sentence: Pwede nako gamiton ang imong telepono?
Ganahan ko sa prutas, labi na sa mangga.

words.meaning: so; then (softens a question or an answer)
even; even if; any (bisan unsa: anything)
words.translation: He worked ⟦even though⟧ he was sick.

words.meaning: you; your (after a noun or a verb)
but (a bit formal; in speech pero)
words.sentence: Gusto ko moadto, apan wala koy oras.
words.translation: I want to go, ⟦but⟧ I don't have time.

words.meaning: there is; is (at a place); to have

words.sentence: Nakita ba nimo ang akong yawe?

words.meaning: me; my; by me (after a noun or a verb)
our (yours and mine; before a noun)

words.sentence: Wala ko kaadto tungod sa ulan.
words.translation: I couldn't go ⟦because of⟧ the rain.

words.meaning: to do; to make; work, deed
him; her; by him or her (after a verb)

words.sentence: Gidala niya ang bata ngadto sa doktor.
words.translation: She took the child ⟦to⟧ the doctor.

words.sentence: Kini ang akong unang adlaw sa trabaho.
words.translation: This is my ⟦first⟧ day at work.

words.meaning: to know (kahibalo: knows how; nahibal-an: found out)

words.sentence: Unsa ang labing dali nga paagi?
Nakaila mi pinaagi sa usa ka higala.
Duha ka tuig na mi dinhi.

words.meaning: you (one person; standing alone or first)
to you; for you; you (after a word like sa)
to bring; to carry; to take along
outside; except (gawas sa); to go out (mogawas)
to him; to her; him; her (after a word like sa)
to; of (before a person's name or a title)
them; their; by them (after a noun or a verb)
to tell; to say; to speak
to them; them (after a word like sa)

words.sentence: Nagdula ang mga bata sa gawas.

words.meaning: your (more than one; before a noun)

words.sentence: Nahulog sa yuta ang akong selpon.

words.meaning: us; our; by us (you and I; after a noun or a verb)
until; up to; as far as

words.translation: It rained, ⟦so⟧ we didn't go out.

words.meaning: glad; happy (nalipay: was glad; malipayon: cheerful; kalipay: joy)
only; just (a bit formal; in speech lang)

words.sentence: Unsa ang ngalan sa imong iro?

words.meaning: so; oh, really (on finding something out)
to come back; to return; again
us; our; by us (not you; after a noun or a verb)
to me; me (after a word like sa)
dead; to die (namatay); to turn off (patya)
to receive; to get; to accept
this; of this (in speech, for niini)

words.sentence: Unsa ang buot ipasabot niini nga pulong?

words.meaning: to you; you (more than one; after a word like sa)
that; of that (in speech, for niana)
last (niadtong Lunes: last Monday); then, that time

words.sentence: Ablihi ang libro sa panid diyes.

words.meaning: that; of that (after a verb or sa)
before; in the past; back then

words.sentence: Ang leyon mao ang hari sa kalasangan.
words.translation: The lion is the ⟦king⟧ of the jungle.

words.sentence: Dako nga kompanya ang akong trabahoan.
Wala ko gitugotan sa akong mama.

words.meaning: to keep (a promise); to carry out

words.sentence: Siya ang nagtudlo nako og Bisaya.
words.translation: She's the one who ⟦taught⟧ me Bisaya.

words.meaning: more than; above; above all (labaw sa tanan)
words.sentence: Naghulat ko labaw sa usa ka oras.
Giisip ko siya nga akong igsoon.

words.meaning: you; your; by you (more than one; after a noun or a verb)
to leave behind (nabilin: got left); to stay (magpabilin)
words.sentence: Nabilin ang akong payong sa jeep.
words.translation: My umbrella ⟦got left⟧ on the jeepney.

words.meaning: front (atubangan: in front of); to face
words.sentence: Naa ko sa atubangan sa simbahan.

words.meaning: to join; to take part; included

words.sentence: Nag-istorya mi mahitungod sa among pamilya.

words.meaning: even; in fact; mao gani: exactly

words.sentence: Dali ra motubo ang mga bata.

words.translation: There are many ⟦kinds⟧ of fish here.

words.sentence: Nainom na nimo ang imong tambal?

words.translation: She's the one who ⟦runs⟧ the store.

words.meaning: case (in court, or of an illness)
words.sentence: Daghan na ang kaso sa dengue.
words.translation: There are a lot of dengue ⟦cases⟧ now.

words.meaning: to us; us (you and I; after a word like sa)

words.translation: ⟦According to⟧ the news, it'll rain tomorrow.
This is ⟦different⟧ from what I ordered.

words.meaning: to join; to connect; to add (in speech)

words.sentence: Siya ang akong suod nga higala.
Oo tuod, ugma diay ang party.

words.meaning: between; in the middle of; among
words.sentence: Naa sa taliwala sa duha ka balay.

words.meaning: to get lost; to disappear (nawala: lost, gone)
